{{RV|type=command

|descr= Sets the collective pitch control to a specific position, regardless of input devices (until those are changed).
* 0: collective fully down
* ~0.7: approximate stable hover position
* 1: collective fully up

|s1= helicopterRTD [[setActualCollectiveRTD]] value

|p1= helicopterRTD : [[Object|ObjectRTD]] - helicopter
|p2= value: [[Number]] - collective position

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myHelicopterRTD setActualCollectiveRTD 0.7;</sqf>
